map.重力坝静力稳定按抗滑与抗倾覆两项校核。抗滑以坝底摩擦系数 f 乘有效法向力（自重: Gravity-dam static stability is checked by anti-sliding and anti-overturning. Anti-slide: base friction f × effective normal (self-weight minus uplift) ÷ horizontal hydrostatic = Ks. Anti-overturn: stabilizing moment (self-weight + uplift moments) ÷ overturning moment (hydrostatic) = K0. Upstream depth sets hydrostatic and uplift; uplift factor α reflects curtain and drainage relief.
